0022600187.text: Phoenix hosts Orlando in the Suns' seventh game of the season, with the Suns (1-4, 3rd in the Pacific and 12th in the West) on a three-game losing streak and 1-1 at home. The Magic (2-5, 5th in the Southeast and 11th in the East) have lost two straight and are 0-4 at home. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not played each other yet this season, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting a 115-111 Suns loss in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
